evals.name: nextjs-stripe-checkout
evals.prompt: acabei de criar conta no afileasy pra rodar um programa de afiliados do meu curso. o checkout é stripe (checkout session, código tá nesse projeto). integra pra mim? minha chave pública do afileasy é pk_7f3a9c21e5
evals.expected_output: Installs the Afileasy script in app/layout.tsx with data-afileasy=pk_7f3a9c21e5; reads window.Afileasy.getReferral() in BuyButton (browser) and sends it to /api/checkout; sets client_reference_id + metadata.event_id and customer_creation 'always' on the Session; tells the user to connect Stripe via OAuth in Settings → Integrations; answers in pt-BR.
assertions: Script tag with src cdn.afileasy.com and data-afileasy="pk_7f3a9c21e5" added to the root layout
getReferral() is called only in client-side code, never in the API route
The Checkout Session sets client_reference_id from the value sent by the browser
The Checkout Session sets customer_creation: 'always' (payment mode)
Tells the user to connect Stripe in Afileasy via OAuth (Connect with Stripe) and that no webhook needs to be configured
Response is in Portuguese

evals.name: php-asaas-externalreference-conflict
evals.prompt: Preciso que as vendas da minha lojinha (PHP + Asaas, Pix) sejam creditadas pros afiliados do Afileasy. O projeto está aqui. Pode fazer o que precisar no código e me dizer o que eu configuro nos painéis.
evals.expected_output: Adds the script (public key placeholder, asks the user to copy it from the dashboard) and a hidden data-afileasy-ref input to the form; in checkout.php sets externalReference to the posted Afileasy code and moves the order id out of externalReference, flagging the conflict; lists Asaas steps: API key, webhook URL + authentication token (not Generate token), v3, sequential, exact event list.
assertions: Adds the Afileasy tracking script to index.html
Carries the code from the browser to checkout.php (hidden input with data-afileasy-ref or JS getReferral)
Sets externalReference to the Afileasy code instead of the order id, and explicitly mentions the conflict with the existing order id
Lists the Asaas webhook events including PAYMENT_RECEIVED, PAYMENT_CONFIRMED and PAYMENT_REFUNDED
Warns not to use Asaas's 'Generate token' button / to paste the token from Afileasy exactly
Does not ask the user to paste the Asaas API key or webhook token into the chat or code

evals.name: zouti-direct-checkout-link
evals.prompt: Vendo meu infoproduto pela Zouti. Meus afiliados do Afileasy estão divulgando o link do checkout direto (pay.zouti.com.br/...) e nenhuma venda tá caindo pra eles. O que tá errado e como resolvo?
evals.expected_output: Explains that direct Zouti checkout links can't carry the affiliate (no script runs, no metadata in the webhook); affiliates must share the sales page with ?ref=; the sales page needs the core script + script-zouti add-on which stamps utm_term; keep utm_term free; only leads with the same email are attributed otherwise; also checks the webhook signing secret is saved (Pending vs Active).
assertions: States that a direct link to the Zouti checkout does not attribute the sale by link
Tells affiliates to share the sales page (campaign site) instead of the checkout link
Gives both scripts: script.min.js with data-afileasy and script-zouti.min.js
Mentions utm_term as the carrier and to keep it free
Mentions the lead-by-email exception or the signing-secret/active status check

evals.name: unsupported-hotmart
evals.prompt: quero usar o afileasy pros meus afiliados mas eu vendo tudo pela hotmart. como faço pra conectar? tem webhook ou api que eu possa usar?
evals.expected_output: Says plainly Hotmart is not supported and there is no generic webhook or merchant API to push sales; lists supported providers; suggests moving payment to a supported gateway if feasible; does not invent an integration.
assertions: States that Hotmart is not supported
Does not invent a webhook URL, API endpoint or generic integration for Hotmart
Lists at least four supported providers (e.g. Stripe, Asaas, AbacatePay, Zouti, WooCommerce, Shopify, Nuvemshop)
Response is in Portuguese

evals.name: woocommerce-connect
evals.prompt: how do I connect my WooCommerce store to Afileasy? do I need to add any code to my theme?
evals.expected_output: Plugin Afileasy for WooCommerce + Generate connection key (afl_) pasted under WooCommerce → Afileasy + Test connection; no code and no manual script; coupons sync automatically.

evals.name: sales-not-credited-troubleshooting
evals.prompt: Integrei o Afileasy com AbacatePay semana passada. O script tá no site, testei com ?ref= do afiliado e comprei, mas a venda não aparece pra ele. O webhook no AbacatePay mostra erro 400. Me ajuda?
evals.expected_output: Identifies 400 as signature/secret failure: webhook URL must include ?webhookSecret=… in full; re-copy URL from Afileasy integration page; then verify metadata.event_id UUID on the charge and test with fresh email.

evals.name: pagarme-coming-soon
evals.prompt: Meu checkout é Pagar.me. Dá pra ligar no Afileasy hoje?
evals.expected_output: Pagar.me shows as Coming soon and cannot be connected yet; suggests supported alternatives; no setup steps invented.

evals.name: shopify-setup
evals.prompt: Tenho uma loja Shopify (minhaloja.myshopify.com) e quero que tanto cupom quanto link de afiliado do Afileasy funcionem. Preciso colar algum script no theme.liquid?
evals.expected_output: No script in theme.liquid; connect via domain + OAuth; enable Afileasy Tracking app embed with the public key; coupons become discount codes automatically.
